review: T14 current Sass source guard-node static review
scope: Read-only source inspection of both maintained roots; no tests, profiles, runtime execution, or repository writes.

findings.detail: PINS[0] still authenticates scripts/current-sass-source.mjs at 4fa09c23f2a55b24fe3e412793f66868e8e5fc17cc161bee6dc4d2706536d346/14051 bytes, while actual current source is eb96891168b146becaf5cbd9e437509a3e2371945e982fc58ca6b343cefb4160/15564 bytes. createCurrentSpinnerSnackContract calls member() for all PINS before creating current source, so construction necessarily rejects. expectedDescriptor.source_subject also uses this stale PINS[0].

planner_bound_propagation: The new planner reference is bound by member(plannerReference) and therefore appears in source.bound. Reviewed current Sass consumers and probes generally derive exact successors dynamically from source.bound (e.g. sass-spinner-snack-c04-source.mjs and current Sass slider reports), so no separate static expected-member cardinality mismatch was found. The stale spinner-snack pin above is the concrete incompatible consumer.

static_design_review.sameinstance_local_node: Guard node is frozen and per-instance, dependencies are empty; preflight/final run assertPhysical without supplied reader callbacks. Consume traverses all bound references through member() (physical read, optional callback equality, physical reread, identity check). Each phase sets active before planner/source assertions and clears it in finally.
static_design_review.reentry: assertCurrent, qualify, and assertHistoricalSource check idle; nested same-instance/alternate plan attempts during callbacks encounter the same active node and fail. Distinct constructor instances have separate closures.
static_design_review.planner_binding: Imports composeCanonicalSourceGuards, checks imported binding identity, function source hash, and physical helper SHA/size before and after each phase; planner file is added to bound references.
static_design_review.semantics: Historical comparison and transition construction remain data-only; public qualify/assertHistoricalSource logic and descriptor are intact apart from binding the helper in bound.
static_design_review.fixture: candidate_fixture copies canonical-source-guard-plan.mjs so actual JS planner can be loaded from fixture. Python SOURCE_JS pin matches actual JS source bytes; JS/Python parity asserts descriptor, transitions, source sets and successors, not bound cardinality.

limitations: No runtime/tests/profile were run, per instruction.
Root tests were still being written at review time; their eventual coverage and outcome are not assessed.
